## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 297 captures during February 2022. The activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other operational issue noted in the available report.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 13 ungradable captures. This was an ungradable rate of 4.4, indicating that most images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable cases were identified during the grading process and were excluded from a reliable clinical assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 62 referable results from the activity recorded at Harbour Eye Clinic. These results require appropriate clinical follow-up in line with the service pathway. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 15 days. This provides the central measure of reporting time for the month and should be considered alongside the activity volume and image-quality findings.
